completion_target.name: ChatGPT Plugin Acceptance and Production Readiness
completion_target.description: Prepare a current-format CW plugin, production MCP architecture, authentication and authorization contracts, security and privacy controls, and submission artifacts without deploying or submitting the service.

requirements.description: Verify the current OpenAI Plugins, MCP, authentication, tunnel, and submission model using official documentation.
evidence_expectations: Dated official-document URLs and current requirement summary.

requirements.description: Keep canonical metadata, skill, MCP wiring, capabilities, assets, and deterministic packaging valid and free of private data.
evidence_expectations: Official validator, skill validator, archive digest, and package contract tests.

requirements.description: Select a production HTTPS MCP topology that preserves local repository ownership and explicit trust boundaries.
evidence_expectations: Accepted ADR comparing four deployment models and documenting data flow and failure modes.

requirements.description: Define OAuth 2.1 MCP authentication, client registration, PKCE, token validation, rotation, expiry, and revocation.
evidence_expectations: Authentication contract and deterministic policy validation.

requirements.description: Define least-privilege scopes, user/workspace/project grants, and a separate high-consequence human authorization ceremony.
evidence_expectations: Capability mapping and nonce/expiry/action/project/evidence binding contract.

requirements.description: Preserve the accepted narrow controlled-action schemas and classify actual surface availability independently of CW support.
evidence_expectations: Registry parity, forbidden-tool absence, idempotency, cancellation, and platform-classification tests.

requirements.description: Threat-model prompt injection, request forgery, scope escape, confused deputy, token theft, replay, authorization impersonation, tenant isolation, leakage, and supply chain.
evidence_expectations: Threat-control matrix and deterministic boundary tests.

requirements.description: Document exactly which source, .cw, evidence, identity, and operational data stays local or crosses each trust boundary.
evidence_expectations: Per-deployment-model data-flow matrix and redaction policy.

requirements.description: Define safe observability, correlations, availability, recovery, incident, key rotation, and local-agent ownership boundaries.
Prepare truthful metadata, support, privacy, security, reviewer notes, test cases, and a submission checklist without submitting.
evidence_expectations: Submission-readiness document with explicit technical and human blockers.

requirements.description: Preserve CLI, local stdio, Codex plugin, Secure MCP Tunnel development, gates, Completion Contracts, and .cw semantics.
evidence_expectations: Full deterministic, MCP, plugin, wheel, docs, and feasible local platform suite.

requirements.description: Truthfully classify public HTTPS, OAuth, production operations, and real submission acceptance that cannot run before implementation and human approval.
evidence_expectations: Explicit BLOCKED status and exact next-stage exit criteria.
